description: Defines the master template for an item in Saga Proto, including its name, type, and base stats.

name.description: The name of the item (e.g., 'Iron Sword').

description.description: A description of the item, potentially including lore.

image.description: An optional image representing the item.

type.description: The classification of the item, used for game logic.

equipableSlot.description: If the item is equipable, this defines which slot it occupies.

maxStackSize.description: The maximum number of this item that can be held in a single stack.

maxDurability.description: The maximum durability of the item, if applicable.

effects.description: Defines the game-mechanical effects of the item, e.g., {'damage': 10, 'heal': 25}.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs for realm-specific properties.
